coverage.detail: gitleaks 8.30.1 is installed but every invocation failed: no git root to scan

limitations: History review examines commit metadata and the set of paths that ever existed.  It does NOT read the content of every historical revision: that requires walking every blob in the object database, which is prohibitively slow on a large repository.  A secret committed inside a normal source file and later edited out will therefore NOT be found here.  Install gitleaks to get content-level history scanning.
